## Vocabulary in Context (6 points)
Read each sentence. Choose one option that explains the bold word or phrase as it is used in that sentence.
**5.** **Between them**, the two cousins saved $80.

Which sentence gives the meaning of **between them** here? (1 point)
A. The two cousins saved $80 each.
B. The two cousins saved $80 altogether.
C. The two cousins divided $80 equally.
Correct answer: <i>B. The two cousins saved $80 altogether.</i>
